verdict.rationale: The RTX 50 Series page documents NVIDIA Project G-Assist, an on-device AI assistant that helps users tune, control, and optimize their system, which is a thin form of AI-generated suggestions inside the product ecosystem. Nothing shows it analyzing the user's own data to produce insights, and DLSS, Studio, and CUDA items are rendering or developer features that don't count here. Missing for 10: documented insights derived from user or system data, details on what suggestions G-Assist surfaces and how, independent or hands-on corroboration of G-Assist's recommendations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: NVIDIA Project G-Assist is an AI assistant powered by your GeForce RTX PC that helps you tune, control, and optimize your system.
